channel.title: MUNICIPAL — LDT4SSC Updates
channel.description: The MUNICIPAL pilot demonstrates a networked ecosystem of Local Digital Twins across energy, mobility, and public services by interconnecting the cities of Murcia and Nicosia. It leverages the SIMPL middleware to enable sovereign, cross-border sharing of data and AI-driven digital services.

item.title: MUNICIPAL Project Kick-Off in Murcia
item.description: The MUNICIPAL pilot project has officially launched following our kick-off meeting hosted by the City Council of Murcia on July 7th and 8th. The event brought together our consortium of seven partners
